Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident and my injuries, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where the accident happened?
A: It was at an intersection in Conroe, Texas. I was making a left turn into a shopping center driveway.
Q: What time of day was it, and what were the conditions like?
A: It was afternoon, and it was clear and dry. The sun was pretty bright, though, so it was hard to see for a second.
Q: Tell me what happened as you began your turn.
A: I had my turn signal on and I was waiting for a gap. I saw a car coming from the opposite direction and I thought I
had time. Then the other vehicle came in faster than I expected and hit the front passenger side of my car.
Q: Did you have any passengers?
A: No, I was alone.
Q: Did you speak with the other driver at the scene?
A: Briefly. They said they had been looking at their phone for a moment, but I didn't see that myself.
Q: How are you feeling now?
A: Not great. I hit my head on the side window and I've had headaches, dizziness, and trouble concentrating. The
doctor said it's a concussion and I've been told to limit screen time and rest.
Q: Have you been seen by a physician since the accident?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care that same day and I've had two follow-up appointments with my primary doctor.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Only that I've missed several days of work and I'm worried about how long recovery will take.
Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
</page>
